Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this text before I began. I opened only PROMPT.md and the image files (plus a pixel-size listing via sips to tell overviews from tiles). I did not read packet.json.

LAYOUT SURVEY

Image sizes: image-001 (1392x1800) and image-010 (1367x1800) are the reduced overviews, one per face. image-002..009 (8 tiles) belong to face 1 (image-001); image-011..018 (8 tiles) to face 2 (image-010). Tiles are probably 2 columns x 4 rows per face; I will confirm each tile's position when I view it.

Face 1 (image-001): single parchment leaf, upright, two columns of a dense small Gothic cursive/textualis hybrid, heavily abbreviated, ruled, roughly 75-80 lines per column. Modern pencil at top margin ("... Msc 432 ..." and other notes) and at lower right ("Fag. 48 r"? / "Fr. 48r"?). Red staining top right. Lower right corner damaged/torn; right edge ragged.
Observations: headings written in larger/darker letters, with paragraph marks, run in-line within the text: col. a has e.g. "...nomi(n)u(m) q(ue) sunt", "Numeri nominu(m) q(uo)t sunt", "Figure nominu(m) quot sunt", "Quot modis no(m)i(n)a co(m)ponu(n)tur", "Casus nominu(m) q(uo)t sunt", "Magis nomen", "Muta nomen"(?) etc.; col. b opens with a red/orange enlarged P initial ("Pronomen quid est") about 6 lines down, followed by darker heading phrases ("Que est agnicio"?, "Que pronomina...", "Pronominum quot accidunt", "Qualitas pronominum", etc.). Some red touches on initials in col. a (lower half). Red initial at foot of col. a ("C"? with following word, catchword-like at bottom). Interpretation (tentative): question-headed text with interspersed short lemmata/headings and longer discursive prose; possibly commentary on a question-and-answer grammar text. No interlinear glosses visible at overview scale. A marginal note at right edge of col. b approx. 60% down ("Om"?).

Face 2: survey to follow when image-010 is viewed.
